// ── 渲染任務 ────────────────────────── function renderTasks() { const list = document.getElementById('taskList'); list.innerHTML = ''; tasks.forEach(t => { const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = `task-card ${t.done ? 'completed task-completed' : ''} ${t.locked ? 'locked' : ''}`; card.dataset.id = t.id; card.innerHTML = `
⠿
${t.icon}
${t.title}
${t.story}
`; list.appendChild(card); }); const total = tasks.length; const done = tasks.filter(t => t.done).length; document.getElementById('taskCount').textContent = `${done} / ${total} 完成`; } // ── 完成單一任務 ────────────────────── function completeTask(id, e) { const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === id); if (!task || task.done || task.locked) return; task.done = true; spawnPetals(e.clientX, e.clientY); renderTasks(); const allDone = tasks.every(t => t.done); if (allDone) { setTimeout(showAllDonePopup, 400); } else { const data = popupData[id] || popupData[1]; setTimeout(() => showTaskPopup(data), 400); } } // ── 單一任務彈窗 ────────────────────── function showTaskPopup(data) { document.getElementById('popupEmoji').textContent = data.emoji; document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = data.title; document.getElementById('popupStory').textContent = data.story; document.getElementById('popupStreak').textContent = `🔥 連續 ${streakDays} 天`; document.querySelector('.popup-close-btn').onclick = closePopup; document.getElementById('popupOverlay').classList.add('show'); document.getElementById('completePopup').classList.add('show'); } // ── 全部完成彈窗 ────────────────────── function showAllDonePopup() { streakDays++; document.getElementById('streakNum').textContent = streakDays; document.getElementById('popupEmoji').textContent = '🎉'; document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = '今天全部完成！'; document.getElementById('popupStory').textContent = `你連續完成了 ${streakDays} 天！\n世界因為你越來越熱鬧了。`; document.getElementById('popupStreak').textContent = `🔥 連續 ${streakDays} 天`; const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.popup-close-btn'); if (streakDays % rewardEvery === 0) { closeBtn.onclick = closePopupThenStamp; closeBtn.textContent = '領取印章 ⭐'; } else { closeBtn.onclick = closePopup; closeBtn.textContent = '繼續冒險 →'; } document.getElementById('popupOverlay').classList.add('show'); document.getElementById('completePopup').classList.add('show'); } function closePopupThenStamp() { closePopup(); setTimeout(showStampPopup, 350); } // ── 印章彈窗 ────────────────────────── function showStampPopup() { document.getElementById('stampOverlay').classList.add('show'); document.getElementById('stampPopup').classList.add('show'); spawnStampFireworks(); } function closeStampPopup() { document.getElementById('stampOverlay').classList.remove('show'); document.getElementById('stampPopup').classList.remove('show'); } // ── 特效 ────────────────────────────── function spawnPetals(x, y) { const emojis = ['🌸','✨','💫','🌼','⭐']; for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = 'star-particle'; s.textContent = emojis[Math.floor(Math.random() * emojis.length)]; s.style.left = x + 'px'; s.style.top = y + 'px'; const angle = Math.random() * 280 - 140; const dist = 60 + Math.random() * 90; s.style.setProperty('--dx', `${Math.cos(angle * Math.PI/180) * dist}px`); s.style.setProperty('--dy', `${Math.sin(angle * Math.PI/180) * dist - 50}px`); s.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.05) + 's'; document.body.appendChild(s); setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 1200); } } function spawnStampFireworks() { const cx = window.innerWidth / 2; const cy = window.innerHeight / 2; for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = 'star-particle'; s.textContent = ['⭐','🌟','✨','💛','🎊','🎉'][Math.floor(Math.random()*6)]; s.style.left = (cx + (Math.random()-0.5) * 80) + 'px'; s.style.top = (cy + (Math.random()-0.5) * 80) + 'px'; s.style.fontSize = (14 + Math.random() * 16) + 'px'; const angle = Math.random() * 360; const dist = 80 + Math.random() * 150; s.style.setProperty('--dx', `${Math.cos(angle * Math.PI/180) * dist}px`); s.style.setProperty('--dy', `${Math.sin(angle * Math.PI/180) * dist - 60}px`); document.body.appendChild(s); setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 1300); }, i * 45); } } function closePopup() { document.getElementById('popupOverlay').classList.remove('show'); document.getElementById('completePopup').classList.remove('show'); } renderTasks();
